great_nebula.title: Capricorn's Great Nebula
great_nebula.description: A large nebula in the centre of [[capricorns_galaxy|Capricorn's Galaxy]] thought to be caused by [[capricorn_emitter|The Emitter]]. Travel to the nebula is extremely dangerous due to its high activity, making it a perfect place for hiding all kinds of interesting regions like [[val_conjunct|The Val Conjunct]].

nexus.title: The Nexus
nexus.description: An area of extreme cosmic activity in the eye of [[great_nebula|The Great Nebula]]. Traversing here is thought to be impossible. Hides the [[ajankajo|Ajankajo]] System.

val_conjunct.title: The Val Conjunct
val_conjunct.description: A region under the supervision of [[capricorns_great_union|Capricorn's Great Union]]. The region holds many mythical places, the best example being [[atalval|Atal'val]]. Travel to the region is very difficult, caused by the [[great_nebula|Great Nebula]].

capricorns_galaxy.title: Capricorn's Galaxy
capricorns_galaxy.description: A galaxy with highly developed civilisations and an active [[capricorn_emitter|Emitter]]. Many proficient in [[äene|Äen'e]]. In [[lynx_cluster|The Lynx Cluster]].

navigators_nebula.title: Navigator's Nebula
navigators_nebula.description: A large nebula fairly close to [[great_nebula|The Great Nebula]]. Hides some systems, the most notable being [[lupovaleai|Lupovalea'i]].

half_dead_void.title: The Half Dead Void
half_dead_void.description: A large void in Galactic Region 10, found next to [[arvens_realm|Arven's Realm]]. Small quantity of active stars. Known for sudden local outbursts of energy, earning it its name as "Half Dead".

ajankajo.title: Ajankajo
ajankajo.description: A mysterious system hidden in [[nexus|The Nexus]]. Travel to here can be deemed impossible due to extreme cosmic activity caused by [[capricorn_emitter|The Emitter]].

tophu.title: Tophu
tophu.description: Capital system of [[atalval|Atal'val]]. Administrative capital of [[capricorns_great_union|Capricorn's Great Union]]. Houses the biggest ecumonopolis of [[val_conjunct|The Val Conjunct]].

lupovaleai.title: Lupovalea'i
lupovaleai.description: A hidden system in [[navigators_nebula|Navigator's Nebula]]. The system is an important meeting point for people of [[capricorns_great_union|Capricorn's Great Union]], and the best known way of travelling to the union's main regions in [[val_conjunct|The Val Conjunct]].

capricorns_great_union.title: Capricorn's Great Union
capricorns_great_union.description: The most powerful union in the galaxy. The union is made up of lots of smaller independent factions. [[tophu|Tophu]] acts as the union's administrative capital system.

olias_union.title: Olia's Union
olias_union.description: Olia's Union is a large union in Galactic Region 8. Composed of smaller independent unions and peoples. [[oliarion|Oliarion]] is the Union's Capital and houses its senate. The Union's systems are guarded by [[olias_security_corporations|The OSC]].

arvens_realm.title: Arven's Realm
arvens_realm.description: A powerful and large union found close to [[half_dead_void|The Half Dead Void]]. Arven's Realm is split into five sectors with their own capitals. The union's capital is [[arven|Arven]].

tellusians.title: The Tellusians
tellusians.description: A mysterious humanoid species from far after Capricorn's Galaxy existed.

aari.title: Ääri
aari.description: Another part of a great mystery behind the Universe.

pol_atal.title: Pol Atal
pol_atal.description: An [[space_travel|interdimensional gateway]] between [[lupovaleai|Lupovalea'i]] and [[ethu|Ethu]]. Main route of travel to [[val_conjunct|The Val Conjunct]].

lumonea_gateway.title: Lumonea Gateway
lumonea_gateway.description: A [[space_travel|Wormhole Machine]] that connects [[lumonea|Lumonea]] to [[lupovaleai|Lupovalea'i]]. This is the main point of entry to the main regions of [[capricorns_great_union|Capricorn's Great Union]] for members in regions near Lumonea, the most notable being [[olias_toopas|Olia's Toopas]] who are the protectors of this gate.

style_and_syntax.description: Style and syntax for the project.
